thesis: A convergence lab should reuse canonical engines, preserve one addressed source across unequal projections, and RETURN bounded evidence of the traversal without claiming donor authority.
new: READ embeds the shared /field-aperture.js READFIELD/RSVP kernel at WORD scale
RSVP, scale, regression, voice and source address come from the canonical reader rather than a Lab clone
PULSE has explicit WITNESS / ×4 PACE / OFF coupling; borrowed tempo never becomes reading authorship
reader focus emits bounded FIELD PULSE focus events without raw source bytes
synthetic PULSE mode emits bounded transport context so READ can be composed locally without another app
READ → LOCI carries the same source and approximates path entry from canonical source progress
READ → DATA carries the same source plus bounded focus witness
FULL READFIELD preserves a session-local handoff into /docs/
phone mode selection becomes a 3×2 thumb rail; desktop retains the spatial ring
ghost pace/typed recall remains available only as an optional trainer
READ source/edit intake collapses after binding so chrome yields to the reading object
READ background stops duplicating the active word; optional race renders only source/ghost/user trajectories
LOCI replaces slice(0,12) with fold-bloom-lab-course/v0.1: direct word loci for small sources or deterministic paragraph/sentence/grouped-word spans for large sources
every LOCI node carries an exact text://start:end address and large-source grouping accounts for every word
LOCI exports an explicit source + route + training RETURN
PULSE exposes live CLOCK / BEAT / PHASE witnesses and explicit READ ×4 / RIDE / COMPOSE routes.
FIELD LAB synthetic rhythm is now a lawful FIELD PULSE transport source consumed by READFIELD, LIVE and Two Dial.
Phone PULSE handoffs are same-tab: they seed tempo/phase before navigation so READFIELD, LIVE or Two Dial can continue the explicit synthetic clock without requiring a background producer tab.
Phone PULSE handoffs are same-tab: tempo/phase is seeded before navigation so READFIELD, LIVE or Two Dial can continue the explicit synthetic clock without relying on a background producer tab.
APERTURE handoff packets may now carry bounded source focus (scale/index/address/char position/source progress/WPM) instead of source text alone
FULL READFIELD restores that bounded focus rather than silently restarting the source
READFIELD → LOCI accepts an explicit session handoff and initializes the addressed course at the nearest source-progress locus
VERSE is a seventh projection over exact local text: line selection carries text://start:end addresses without becoming a second poetry editor.
VERSE → POEM MAP passes source + focused line through field-verse-handoff/v0.1; Poem Map remains authoring authority.
VERSE ↔ READ and VERSE ↔ LOCI preserve source text plus nearest character/locus focus.
source-scoped BOOKMARK / FLAG / ARC text marks persist locally and remain visible/useful across VERSE, READ and LOCI.
READ can mark the current canonical reader focus and jump to the next source-scoped text mark.
LOCI can mark an addressed locus and jump to the next source-scoped mark while exact course spans remain authoritative.
VERSE → REPLAY compiles a bounded TEXT handoff using the existing replay-score contract; replay timing is explicitly presentation-only.
phone mode controls use a 44px floor while the desktop ring expands from six to seven unequal projections.
DATA gains a shared six-line STATE / CHANGE projection with editable before/after stacks, exact Δ positions, copyable state tokens, and direct line editing in the visual field.

Inbound Poem Map VERSE handoffs expose an exact same-origin ↩ POEM MAP caller return after source/focus restoration; returning is navigation only and does not import LAB marks or projection state into poem authorship.
FIELD LAB 0.3.3 adds one bounded session RETURN: traversed modes, profile/address/source witnesses, and current-projection evidence without copying raw source bytes into a new store.
PULSE 0.3.4 replaces one nearest-pulse percentage with a bounded LOCK → CROSS → RETURN timing-training loop over the existing synthetic FIELD PULSE clock.
PULSE renders three concentric temporal witnesses: quarter-note meter plus both selected polyrhythm streams (3:2 / 4:3 / 5:4), with the current training target visually privileged.

Tap evidence preserves signed early/late asynchrony, tempo-relative lock score, bias, jitter, a bounded lag-1 phase-correction proxy and return-to-meter delta; these are training witnesses, not neurological diagnoses.
A quiet quarter-note meter voice is scheduled alongside the two polyrhythm voices so LOCK and RETURN have an audible ground rather than requiring inference from ratio coincidences.
PULSE evidence and FoldBloomFieldLab runtime now expose the psychophysics version, training phase/target/progress, bounded summary and return delta while FIELD PULSE authority remains NONE.
The existing PULSE-embedded VOICE spectrum now overlays target/heard pitch history and beat boundaries, adding onset Δ and center-hold witnesses without adding an eighth Lab projection.
VOICE temporal evidence is derived through the shared fold-bloom-voice-training-trace/v0.1 contract and remains local, bounded and EVIDENCE_ONLY.
PULSE psychophysics 0.2 makes ring/lane count explicit: 1 = meter M, 2 = M+A, 3 = M+A+B; enabled lanes are both visible and audible.
PULSE FOCUS is independent of ratio and lane count: AUTO preserves LOCK→CROSS→RETURN over available lanes; fixed M/A/B provides free single-lane timing study without advancing the trainer.
FIELD PULSE transport and PULSE export retain selected ratio, lane set and focus as authority-NONE context/evidence; downstream consumers may ignore those witnesses.
Embedded VOICE is explicitly an optional witness with OPEN FULL VOICE pulse-linked handoff; VOICE remains pitch/pattern/microphone authority and PULSE remains rhythm authority.
constraints: READFIELD/APERTURE remains reader authority; FIELD LAB owns no second segmentation/cursor/RSVP truth
FIELD PULSE remains ephemeral coordination with authority NONE
CARRY is explicit human action and never silently mutates another projection
PULSE ×4 changes pace only; it cannot change source focus, segmentation or meaning
LOCI grouping/layout is derived evidence; exact text spans are preserved, but mnemonic meaning remains human/training evidence. The local course adapter is not promoted shared core.
profiles change presentation only
CURRENT was updated only after PR #207 merged, preserving its coordination ownership during implementation.
synthetic PULSE timing may coordinate tempo/beat/phase/quantum but never becomes audio/source authority.
Poem Map remains poetry authoring authority; FIELD LAB does not own candidate generation, form scoring, revision ancestry or poem semantics.
Text marks are human-authored source evidence. They do not infer meaning, literary quality or canonical relations.
REPLAY of text maps source progress into presentation time only; it must preserve exact text addresses and never claim the poem has native temporal structure.
The local text-mark bridge remains LAB-scoped until ordinary cross-layer use proves a broader shared contract is warranted.
STATE / CHANGE notation must only be used when six explicit binary conditions are meaningful; do not compress richer objects merely to fit the grammar.
VERSE caller RETURN is navigation-only: FIELD LAB may not write poem text, marks, timing, or inferred claims back into Poem Map on return.

LAB session RETURN is EVIDENCE_ONLY: it may describe traversal and current projection state, but cannot mutate or supersede LIVE, READFIELD, Poem Map, FIELD PULSE, LOCI course, INK, or domain-state authority.

PULSE timing metrics are descriptive behavioral witnesses only; phase-correction proxy, bias, jitter and lock score must not be presented as diagnosis, neural measurement, musical ability, or pleasure.
Rhythmic-complexity/groove research motivates keeping challenge learnable; the runtime does not claim a universal optimal syncopation level or infer subjective pleasure.
VOICE onset and center-hold evidence is descriptive practice evidence only; it must not be presented as singing-quality, neurological or health assessment.
PULSE ring count must keep visible lanes, audible scheduler lanes and exported configuration in agreement; it does not change source/audio authority.
VOICE and PULSE remain separate projections. FIELD PULSE may lend clock context only; neither projection acquires the other's authored targets or evidence.
